name: Paycor
description_en:
Paycor is a US-oriented HCM platform whose payroll product connects employee pay, tax processing, reporting and self-service. Its wider HR, talent, benefits and workforce products are separately scoped; the payroll page itself notes that many customers purchase Paycor Time alongside payroll to capture hourly data.

Useful evaluation points include scheduled AutoRun, proactive warnings about payroll setup data, employee paystub preview and a customer sandbox. These are vendor-documented capabilities, not evidence of an executed pay run, guaranteed compliance or an all-inclusive flat price.
description_zh:
Paycor 是面向美国的人力资本管理平台，工资产品连接员工付款、税务处理、报表和自助。更广的 HR、人才、福利和人员运营有各自范围；工资页也说明很多客户另购 Paycor Time 采集小时工数据。

评估可关注定时 AutoRun、工资设置资料预警、员工工资单预览和客户沙箱。这些是供应商记录的能力，不代表已执行工资、保证合规或固定价全包。

core_features.explanation_en: The product page describes scheduled payroll processing, real-time changes and employee paystub preview up to three days before payday.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品页描述定时工资处理、实时修改，以及最早发薪前三天的员工工资单预览。

core_features.explanation_en: The dashboard flags issues such as missing tax IDs, invalid addresses and deposit discrepancies; tax processing includes W-2/1099.
core_features.explanation_zh: 看板提示缺失税号、无效地址及存款资料差异，税务处理包括 W-2/1099。

core_features.explanation_en: The vendor describes a separate environment for testing configurations, privileges and workflows without affecting live HR/payroll data.
core_features.explanation_zh: 供应商描述独立环境，用于测试配置、权限及流程而不影响实际 HR 工资数据。

pricing.summary_en: Size/bundle-specific quote required. Monthly run count is unlimited per FAQ, but amounts, service extras, contract and sandbox costs are not disclosed.
pricing.summary_zh: 需按规模和组合报价。FAQ 称月度运行不限，但金额、附加服务、合同及沙箱费用未披露。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 自动化前检查工资预警
sections.en: The payroll page describes alerts for missing or invalid tax IDs, unverified addresses and direct-deposit discrepancies, plus recommendations using home and work addresses. Those signals are useful inputs to review, not a substitute for correct employer registrations or employee withholding data. An illustrative pilot could intentionally omit a fictional tax identifier, confirm the warning, correct it and inspect the payroll preview. Do not activate scheduled processing until the organization has agreed which warnings block approval and who resolves them; actual blocking behavior was not tested.
sections.zh: 工资页描述缺失无效税号、未验证地址及直接存款差异提醒，并根据居住和工作地址给出建议。这些信号有助于审核，但不能替代正确雇主登记或员工代扣资料。试运行可故意漏掉虚构税号，确认提醒、更正后检查工资预览。组织需约定哪些预警阻止批准、由谁处理，再启用定时运行；实际阻断行为未测试。

sections.title_en: Trace an hourly change through preview and reports
sections.title_zh: 把小时工变更追踪到预览及报表
sections.en: Paycor says recurring salary can be entered directly, while hourly collection often uses Paycor Time or another connected timekeeping or POS system. Timecard approval, pay interval and correction precede a pay run. The payroll product describes employee paystub preview up to three days before payday and cash-requirement, audit, liability and labor-distribution reports. A useful parallel case would include overtime and a changed deduction, then reconcile approved hours, net pay, cash needs and employee documents. An early preview is not settlement, and earning access or a pay card requires its own eligibility and terms.
sections.zh: Paycor 称固定工资可直接录入，小时工采集则常用 Paycor Time 或连接的考勤、POS。工时批准、发薪周期及更正先于工资运行。产品描述最早发薪前三天员工预览，以及资金需求、审计、税负及人工分配报表。并行示例可包含加班和扣款变化，再核对已批工时、实发、资金需求及员工文档。提前预览不代表结算，提前支取和工资卡也有独立资格及条款。

sections.title_en: Use the documented sandbox for configuration review
sections.title_zh: 利用文档中的沙箱检查配置
sections.en: The product page offers a Customer Sandbox for configurations, security privileges, workflows and training. Before migration, request a demonstration of manager access, a rejected payroll change and a correction to a completed period. The public description does not establish whether all integrations or payment rails can be simulated, how frequently the sandbox refreshes or what it costs. Treat a sandbox demonstration and live payroll acceptance as separate checks. Do not assume every HCM feature in the navigation, such as scheduling, benefits or talent management, is included with the selected payroll bundle.
sections.zh: 产品页提供用于配置、权限、流程及培训的 Customer Sandbox。迁移前应要求演示经理访问、工资变更拒批及已完成期间更正。公开说明未确立全部集成或付款路径是否可模拟、刷新频率及费用，沙箱演示与真实工资验收应分开。也不能把导航中的排班、福利或人才等全部 HCM 功能视为已含在工资组合。

sections.title_en: Unlimited runs do not establish the total fee
sections.title_zh: 不限运行不代表总费用已明确
sections.en: The pricing page routes businesses below 50 employees to a custom quote and separates the larger-company plan route. It states there is no limit to monthly payroll runs but publishes no numerical rate or enough fee detail to conclude every run, form or added service is free. Request payroll, time collection, tax filing, year-end forms, benefits, interfaces, sandbox, migration, support and contract terms as explicit items. No general free plan, trial duration or open-source license was established from these pages.
sections.zh: 价格页把 50 人以下企业引向定制报价，并区分较大企业套餐入口，说明每月工资次数不限，但未公开数值费率或足够费用细节，不能据此认为每次运行、表单及附加服务都免费。应明确询价工资、工时、报税、年末表单、福利、接口、沙箱、迁移、支持及合同。所读页面未确立普遍免费套餐、试用期限或开源许可。

sections.title_en: Reconcile a parallel period before cutover
sections.en: Paycor merits evaluation when a US employer needs payroll tied to HR and optionally workforce management. A team seeking a simple document generator or verified global payroll should define a different service requirement before choosing. Prepare tax and banking setup, earning codes, YTD totals, time-source ownership and approvers, then compare reports and a corrected paystub against the existing source. Funding cutoff, specific regional obligations, exact bundle, signed liability terms, hosting, audit retention, complete exports and recovery remain unverified. No tenant, sandbox, time capture, payroll, filing or transfer was executed.
sections.zh: 美国雇主需要工资关联 HR 并可选人员运营时，可以评估 Paycor。仅需文档生成或已验证全球工资的团队，应先定义不同服务需求。需准备税务银行设置、收入编码、年内累计、工时来源责任和审批人，再把报告及更正工资单与旧来源比较。供款截止、地区义务、具体组合、责任条款、托管、审计保留、完整导出及恢复均未核实，未执行租户、沙箱、工时、工资、申报或转账。

research_gaps.en: Exact bundle, fees, funding cutoff, regional scope, hosting, exports and recovery remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体组合、费用、供款截止、地区范围、托管、导出及恢复未核实。
